results.title: Wild Horse Nine
results.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

results.title: The Strange Little Cat
results.overview: It is a Saturday in autumn, and Karin and Simon are visiting their parents and youngest sister Clara. This family gathering provides the occasion for a dinner together, at which other relatives appear over the course of the day. While the family members animate the apartment’s space with their conversations, everyday activities and cooking preparations, the cat and dog range through the various rooms. they too become a central element in this quotidian familial dance that repeatedly manifests stylized elements, disrupting any naturalistic mode of presentation. In this way, adjoining spaces open up between family drama, fairy tale and the psychological study of a mother.

results.title: Giants
results.overview: Two naïve woodland creatures stumble inside a towering Giant and discover a euphoric world of spectacle. But when one falls under its spell, the other uncovers a terrifying truth behind the Giant’s entranced inhabitants.

results.title: Death Castle
results.overview: Described as 'The Office' meets 'Frankenstein', blending satirical monster movie tropes with screwball relationship comedy. Featuring high-end traditional animation, Death Castle promises a distinctive visual appeal and a bold comedic tone.

results.title: Mama Bear
results.overview: Floyd's sleep is disrupted by disturbing phone calls that escalate from annoying to menacing when he realizes a doppelgänger may be nearby.

results.title: Pertenencias
results.overview: Migrant women gather in a Buenos Aires kitchen to prepare hallacas and share their experiences between Venezuela and Argentina, reflecting on memory and belonging.

results.title: Sketchy
results.overview: In half-drawn Sketchtown, a stick-man courier has three days to get a half-inked starlet and her three keys to the top of the Tower before the glossy, AI-smoothed Final Cut polishes away everything unfinished. With Uwe Boll as himself.

results.title: Bleed Out
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, The Dawn taught his people to survive by wearing a mask, no more feeling, no more pain. He has been hiding behind his own ever since he lost Ava.  Alone in the desert, his memories come back, and with them an idea he had never imagined, there might be a way beyond this world.  He returns to his group, gathered in an abandoned warehouse, and takes off his mask in front of them for the first time. But no one understands. So he dances, alone at first, until someone else takes off their mask, then another. In the rain, they dance through the night, until exhaustion, until dawn breaks.

results.title: Infinite Rifts
results.overview: In the wake of a breakup and the sudden death of his uncle, Jace inherits a forgotten sci-fi novel. As the book folds into his reality, he's drawn into a surreal meditation on grief, memory, and the small, stubborn messes we leave behind.

results.title: Time's Up
results.overview: A horror short film made by Soulular.

results.title: The Mountains
results.overview: As the guerrilla group disintegrates following Girón’s death, a female guerrilla fighter dictates to a comrade the final letter she is sending to her mother.

results.title: Angelina
results.overview: A reckless, irresponsible Ukrainian student in Italy goes to a hospital after a street fight the night before. By chance, he meets a very young girl from Ukraine, days away from dying of cancer, whose last wish is to speak her native language with someone one more time. And for the first time, the boy who threw his life away begins to realize what he needs to do for her.

results.title: We Tell Stories
results.overview: 4 work friends sit down to play a Ouija type boardgame and get their questions answered from beyond. Instead they get way more than they expected. Instead they get far more than they expected as they fight to be as honest as possible with a malevolent force attempting to uncover their darkest secrets.

results.title: Rebel & Jango: Act I
results.overview: On the colonized Caribbean island of Dominica, Rebel and Jango inherit the unfinished revolution that claimed their parents’ lives. As colonial rule tightens, the two lovers  take up resistance in their own ways, confronting the personal cost of building freedom in the land that raised them.

results.title: The Manor: First Encounter
results.overview: At the turn of the century, a Manhattan family’s move to an Upstate New York hamlet inadvertently awakens an extra-terrestrial force that torments the community.

results.title: Don’t Eat the Nephew
results.overview: On his 17th birthday, an isolated teenage boy grapples with a disturbing and newfound craving after accidentally tasting his own blood. What begins as a moment of curiosity quickly spirals into an unsettling obsession, blurring the line between hunger and identity.  Surrounded by a family that seems both oblivious and eerily suggestive, the boy becomes increasingly paranoid that others can sense, or even share, his dark secret.  As tensions rise, his uncle’s behaviour turns from inappropriate to disturbingly predatory, suggesting a deeper, inherited hunger lurking within the family. Drawn back to the woods where it all began, the boy is forced into a horrifying confrontation that reveals the true nature of his condition.  In a grim twist of fate, victim becomes predator, and the cycle continues...

results.title: Sam's Halloween Safety Tips Part 3
results.overview: Accidents happen. Especially around Halloween. Especially around Sam. Fortunately, Pumpums the talking pumpkin is back with some tips to stay safe this Halloween!
